caption: A person uses a pair of pliers to open a stubborn metal bottle, bending the cap slightly in the process.
positive_analysis:
Pliers jaws gripping the cap rim -> cap bends slightly and pries open.
Hand applying force through pliers -> stubborn metal seal begins to separate.
Bottle neck remains stable -> deformed cap edges pull away from the rim.
physical_analysis:
Pliers jaws gripping the cap rim -> cap bends slightly and pries open.
Hand applying force through pliers -> stubborn metal seal begins to separate.
Bottle neck remains stable -> deformed cap edges pull away from the rim.
negative_analysis:
The pliers' jaws clamp the bottle's upper rim, applying localized force to the material.
Increased pressure from the handles may deform or crack the bottle's neck.
The hand maintains a steady grip on the pliers to control the tool's position.
